title: Siegard knowledge decision
description: Frontmatter contract for a `decision` node in a consumer repository's knowledge tree. This is product surface: it ships, and the records it governs are the consumer's own business decisions — why a domain choice was made and what it rejected. It governs the consumer's own records and nothing the framework's authors decide about the framework. `knowledge-decision/1` carried a `proposed | accepted | superseded` status; ADR-0018 removed it with the rest of the knowledge lifecycle, and `additionalProperties: false` now rejects it rather than ignoring it. A record in the tree is one the consumer decided.

id.description: Four-digit id, unique within the knowledge tree's decision directory and never reused. Must be a quoted string: YAML reads an unquoted 0010 as octal 8 and an unquoted 0008 as a string, so the unquoted form is neither safe nor type-stable.

title.description: The decision stated as an outcome.

contract_version.description: A consumer rejects an artifact it was not built to read rather than inferring version from shape.
